STAIR.gloss: support consisting of a place to rest the foot while ascending or descending a stairway
STAIR.definition: Support consisting of a place to rest the foot while ascending or descending a stairway.
STAIR.example: He paused on the bottom step.

SITAR.definition: A stringed instrument of India; has a long neck and movable frets; has 6 or 7 metal strings for playing and usually 13 resonating strings.

STAR.gloss: a celestial body of hot gases that radiates energy derived from thermonuclear…
STAR.definition: (astronomy) a celestial body of hot gases that radiates energy derived from thermonuclear reactions in the interior.

ARTS.gloss: studies intended to provide general knowledge and intellectual skills
ARTS.definition: Studies intended to provide general knowledge and intellectual skills (rather than occupational or professional skills).
ARTS.example: The college of arts and sciences.

AIRS.gloss: affected manners intended to impress others
AIRS.definition: Affected manners intended to impress others.
AIRS.example: Don't put on airs with me.

TSAR.definition: A male monarch or emperor (especially of Russia prior to 1917).

AIR.gloss: a mixture of gases required for breathing
AIR.definition: A mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of.

ART.definition: The products of human creativity; works of art collectively.

SIR.gloss: term of address for a man
SIR.definition: Term of address for a man.

RAT.gloss: any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse
RAT.definition: Any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse.

IRA.gloss: belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong
IRA.definition: Belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong (personified as one of the deadly sins).

TAR.gloss: any of various dark heavy viscid substances obtained as a residue
TAR.definition: Any of various dark heavy viscid substances obtained as a residue.

SARI.gloss: a dress worn primarily by Hindu women
SARI.definition: A dress worn primarily by Hindu women; consists of several yards of light material that is draped around the body.
